tasks.text: Note that because BDDSoftAssertions is stateful you should use a new instance of BDDSoftAssertions per test method. Also, if you forget to call assertAll() at the end of your test, the test will pass even if any assertion objects threw exceptions (because they're proxied, remember?). So don't forget. You might use {@link JUnitBDDSoftAssertions} or {@link AutoCloseableBDDSoftAssertions} to get assertAll() to be called automatically.
